abstract: BACKGROUND: Assessment of immunocompetence in non-seminomatous testicular cancer (NSTC) patients. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In the peripheral blood of 43 patients with NSTC, lymphocyte subsets, lymphocyte reactivity to mitogens, NK cell activity as well as neutrophil and monocyte phagocytic functions were studied. RESULTS: The proportion and number of T- and B- lymphocytes, lymphocyte reactivity to mitogens as well as neutrophil and monocyte phagocytic functions were equal in patients with localized disease and in those with metastatic disease and they not differ from those in controls. The NK cell number and NK cell activity, however, were significantly impaired in both patient groups. The patients with metastatic disease had a lower NK cell activity than those with localized disease. One year after the completion of anticancer treatment, the NK cell number and cytotoxic activity recovered in both groups of patients. CONCLUSION: These results suggest that patients with NSTC are primarily deficient in NK cell number and their cytotoxic function influence the host's ability to control the proliferation and spread of tumor cells.
abstract_ja: 背景: 非セミノーマ性精巣がん(NSTC)患者の免疫能を評価する。材料と方法: NSTC患者43例の末梢血で、リンパ球サブセット、マイトジェンに対するリンパ球反応性、NK細胞活性、好中球と単球の貪食能を検討した。結果: 限局性病変の患者と転移性疾患の患者で、T・Bリンパ球の割合と数、マイトジェンに対するリンパ球反応性、好中球と単球の貪食能は同等であり、対照とも差がなかった。しかし、NK細胞数とNK細胞活性は両群で有意に低下していた。転移性疾患の患者は、限局性病変の患者よりNK細胞活性が低かった。抗がん治療終了から1年後には、両群ともNK細胞数と細胞傷害活性は回復した。結論: これらの結果から、NSTC患者は主にNK細胞数が不足しており、その細胞傷害活性が宿主の腫瘍細胞の増殖と拡がりを制御する能力に影響すると考えられる。
